obligations.source_text: Create one complex landscape editorial photograph that makes a randomly assigned barred-spiral-galaxy visual meaning independently inspectable in the same frame as an original visibly adult astronomer whose appearance is guided by the attached portrait in appearance-only reference mode.

bindings.bulge_phrase: one luminous central bulge remains centered inside the galactic disk
bindings.bar_phrase: an elongated stellar bar visibly crosses the central bulge
bindings.arm_phrase: spiral arms begin near both ends of the central bar
bindings.disk_phrase: the bulge bar and arms remain embedded in one coherent galactic disk
